style.toneOfVoice: Lovingly crafted, our star-studded Christmas wreath is packed with forest pinecones and bright holly berries, with sprigs of pine, shimmering baubles, and gorgeous red roses for a traditional festive colour palette. A truly impressive decoration which is sure to create an eye-catching feature on your front door, or even displayed indoors. Each wreath is complete with a natural wood star tag which the Dibor personalisation team can engrave with a bespoke message. Dia. 35cm.
